ambiguities.text: The storage root is not part of the Account dataclass but is required for encoding.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume storage root is computed separately from account storage trie and passed to encode_account() function. This separation is intentional for modularity.

ambiguities.text: VersionedHash is defined as Hash32 alias without explicit version byte handling.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume version byte is the first byte of the Hash32, with current blob version being 0x01. This follows EIP-4844 specification.

implicit_assumptions.description: The EMPTY_ACCOUNT constant is used consistently across all code paths to represent non-existent accounts.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent empty account representation could lead to state inconsistencies or incorrect balance calculations.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Bytes, Uint, U256, Hash32 types from ethereum base modules correctly handle all edge cases.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Type overflow or underflow could corrupt account state or enable balance manipulation.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot craft Account data that encodes to the same bytes as a different valid account.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could enable state confusion attacks where different accounts appear identical in trie.
